facts.text: Eve? Sit. Snack cake for you, movie on the screen. Please stay.
facts.why: Not a line in the film. Wall-E barely speaks (Ta-da, Directive, Eve). The panel is headed 'From the flight deck', and the Captain's real line about wanting to live fits the Axiom setting.
facts.fix: I don't want to survive! I want to live!

fix_note.text: I don't want to survive! I want to live!

vibe.verdict: Good Axiom setting and the plant in a boot and spork are right, but it misses the best Wall-E moments and the tone is flat.
missing: Wall-E's cooler of treasures at his truck (opening scene)
Wall-E's 'Hello, Dolly!' video tape and the hands holding (his home)
The Captain's 'Define hoedown' and 'Define dancing' (Captain, learning about Earth)
The Rubik's cube and the spork drawer (Wall-E's collection)
Hal the cockroach as the pet
ideas: Swap 'Golden sponge cakes' for 'Hello Dolly' hand-hold heart cookies to bring in the film's love story
Replace 'Cold pressed watermelon juice' note with 'Define farming' and the Captain learning what pizza grows from
Swap 'Trash cube puffed rice bars' for named 'Rubik's cube' bars with coloured squares (treasure from Wall-E's collection)
